image_query: Dilwara Jain temple Mount Abu marble ceiling carving
tweets: Dilwara, Mount Abu — plain sandstone outside, by Jain design: humility before divinity. Step inside, and the marble turns to lace. Ceilings and pillars are carved so fine the stone seems to glow, cut in concentric rings barely thicker than paper.

The oldest shrine, Vimal Vasahi, rose in 1031 CE for Tirthankara Adinatha; Luna Vasahi followed in 1230, raised by brothers Vastupal and Tejpal for Neminatha. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history.
